A progressive tax involves a tax rate that increases (or progresses) as taxable income increases. It imposes a lower tax rate on low-income earners and a higher tax rate on those with a higher income. This is usually achieved by creating tax brackets that group taxpayers by income range. Hence, a tax system should contain progressive tax rates based on the tax-payer’s ability to pay and sacrifice
